title: openmls patch: PublicGroup leaf lifetime policy
description: Add an opt-out of leaf lifetime verification to PublicGroup on the openmls mimid-0.9.1 branch (MarkAtwood/openmls), covering from_external and commit/proposal validation, per decision mimid-1wgh.4.38. Additive API only; existing behaviour unchanged. Regression test that fails before. Push to fork (approved by Mark 2026-10-17), then bump the [patch.crates-io] rev in mimid. Upstream report only with Mark's separate OK.
